newsitem.title: USA: Automated Healthcare says to move, add jobs.
newsitem.headline: Automated Healthcare says to move, add jobs.

text.p: McKesson Corp's Automated Healthcare Inc unit plans to move to Pittsburgh from O'Hara township and plans to add 70 jobs during the next three years, it was announced by the city of Pittburgh on Thursday.

The company, which was bought last year for $65 million by San Francisco-based pharmaceutical wholesaler McKesson Corp, said it will move from nearby O'Hara township in the spring of 1998. The company currently employs 90 people.

The company said the city of Pittsburgh paid $3.7 million, using state financing and Enterprise Zone tax incentives, to build the new 45,000 square foot headquarters. The building has room to expand an additional 15,000 square feet during the next ten years.
